obfuscation_indicators: subject to certain risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure presents strong quantified 2012 growth and profitability, but relies on favorable industry conditions and continued new-product execution. Key risks include customer consolidation and margin concessions, supplier and transportation dependence, demand volatility, product development uncertainty, and reliance on management estimates. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer is largely boilerplate and limits specificity regarding the magnitude and likelihood of adverse outcomes.
